notes: backdrop $0F black is background palette 0 entry 0 and is shared with every sprite palette
background palettes cover the composite of the seven scrolling layers in data/title.json, 16x16 screen areas
sprite palettes cover every 8x8 tile of the car, the logo, the sign, the cone, the window, the font and the cursor, 3 colours plus transparency
solved by tools/art/scene_palette.py from the art on disk, then checked again by tools/nes_composite_check.py
rule: NES: 1 backdrop shared by both layers, 4 background palettes of 3 entries on 16x16 areas, 4 sprite palettes of 3 entries plus transparency on 8x8 tiles; every entry is a data/nes_palette.json entry number
